name: sheet
description: A source-owned slide-in Sheet for Dioxus, composing the owned Dialog primitive.

documentation.compositionNote: Composes the owned dialog primitive directly (SheetTitle/SheetDescription/Sheet re-export the Dialog primitive's parts); the styled wrapper only adds the slide-in side variant and positioning.
documentation.accessibility: Composes `packages/adico-primitives/src/dialog.rs` directly (the same `role="dialog"`/`aria-modal="true"`/focus-trap behavior as `Dialog`), styled as an edge-anchored panel instead of a centered modal.
documentation.keyboard: Same as `Dialog`: Escape closes it, plus the registry facade's manual backdrop `onclick` workaround for the same `use_outside_dismiss` web defect.
